Name: Junimatic Greenhouse Workers
Author: Yousv
Description:
[center][color=#8e7cc3][size=6][b]Junimatic Greenhouse Workers[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=5][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22672][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22672][color=#93c47d][b]Junimatic[/b][/color][/url] [color=#ffffff][b]is[/b][/color][color=#e06666][b] REQUIRED[/b][/color][color=#ffffff][b], this is just an addon.[/b][/color][/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Place Junimatic portals in the greenhouse to automate planting, watering, fertilizing, and harvesting.[/size]
[line]
[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51537/51537-1788330029-1742475781.png[/img][/center]
[line]
[center][b][color=#b4a7d6][size=6]Features[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Automation[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Place a Junimatic portal in the greenhouse and a junimo will handle all crop work automatically.[/*]
[*]Harvests ready crops, fertilizes soil, plants seeds, and waters crops.[/*]
[*]Bulk carry mode: junimo takes as many seeds and fertilizers as needed for pending work in one chest visit, reducing trips. [color=#b4a7d6](on by default)[/color][/*]
[*]Auto-waters crops immediately after planting. [color=#b4a7d6](on by default)[/color][/*]
[*]Works with any Junimatic unlock condition: Crops, Animals, Mining, Fishing, Forestry, Indoor Pots, or Always.[/*]
[*]Supports modded greenhouse maps.[/*]
[*]Optionally work in any indoor location with tilled soil, not just the greenhouse. (off by default)[/*]
[*]Optionally deliver harvested crops to a mini shipping bin instead of a chest. (off by default)[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Host is authoritative, farmhands see the same behavior.[/*]
[*]Works in both single player and multiplayer.[/*]
[/list][quote][center][size=4][color=#ea9999][b]IMPORTANT[/b][/color][/size][/center]
[color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Junimos from this mod require their own portal so for example if you have a portal for fruit trees in your greenhouse you need to put down another portal for the farming junimos.[/size][/color][/quote]
[line]
[center][b][color=#b4a7d6][size=6]Configuration[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][size=4]All options can be configured in-game with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or by editing config.json.[/size][/center]
[spoiler][left][color=#b4a7d6][size=3][b]General[/b][/size][/color][/left]
[list]
[*][b]Enable workers[/b] - Dispatch greenhouse workers from Junimatic portals. [color=#b4a7d6](default: on)[/color][/*]
[*][b]Unlock requirement[/b] - Junimatic quest required before workers appear: Crops, Animals, Mining, Fishing, Forestry, IndoorPots, or Always. [color=#b4a7d6](default: Crops)[/color][/*]
[*][b]Junimo speed[/b] - Movement speed of greenhouse junimos (vanilla is 3). [color=#b4a7d6](default: 3)[/color][/*]
[*][b]Junimos work any indoors[/b] - Normally Junimos only work in the greenhouse. Turning this on allows Junimo portals to work in any indoor location with tilled soil. Does not work outdoors. [color=#b4a7d6](default: off)[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=3][b]Tasks[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Plant seeds[/b] - Plant the most expensive seed from a chest into empty tilled soil. [color=#b4a7d6](default: on)[/color][/*]
[*][b]Water crops[/b] - Water planted soil that still needs water. [color=#b4a7d6](default: on)[/color][/*]
[*][b]Fertilize soil[/b] - Apply the most expensive fertilizer from a chest to tilled soil that can accept it, including right after planting. [color=#b4a7d6](default: on)[/color][/*]
[*][b]Harvest crops[/b] - Harvest ready crops back into a chest. [color=#b4a7d6](default: on)[/color][/*]
[*][b]Water after planting[/b] - Water a seedling immediately instead of on a later trip. [color=#b4a7d6](default: on)[/color][/*]
[*][b]Bulk carry[/b] - When enabled, junimo takes as many seeds/fertilizers as needed for pending work in one chest visit. [color=#b4a7d6](default: on)[/color][/*]
[*][b]Allow shipping[/b] - When enabled, harvested goods are shipped to a mini shipping bin in the network instead of deposited in chests. [color=#b4a7d6](default: off)[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=3][b]Debug[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Verbose logging[/b] - Log detailed worker activity to the SMAPI console. [color=#b4a7d6](default: off)[/color][/*]
[*][b]Show path debug[/b] - Draw walkable tiles, soil access points, chests, and the junimo's planned route when in the greenhouse. [color=#b4a7d6](default: off)[/color][/*]
[*][b]Show task bubbles[/b] - Draw a speech bubble above each worker with its current task. [color=#b4a7d6](default: off)[/color][/*]
[*][b]Never drop items[/b] - When a tile is already planted or destroyed, skip it and keep working instead of dropping carried items. Items are returned to the chest if no more work remains. [color=#b4a7d6](default: off)[/color][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14075][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22672]Junimatic[/url] (required)[/size][/b][/center]
[center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26194][b][size=4]QuickSave[/size][/b][/url][/center]
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14075][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22672]Junimatic[/url][/*]
[/list]
Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game configuration. Without it, edit the config.json file directly.
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Junimatic.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
